description: This file defines Data Transfer Object (DTO) records and mapping extension methods for entities related to assets, maintenance tasks, and schedules in the Preventive Maintenance Management System. It also includes static methods for converting domain models to DTOs.

classes.name: AssetCreateDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new asset.

classes.name: TaskDto
classes.description: DTO for representing maintenance task data.

classes.name: TaskCreateDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new maintenance task.

classes.name: ScheduleCreateDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new schedule.

methods.name: ToDto for Asset
methods.description: Maps an Asset domain model to AssetDto.

methods.name: ToDto for MaintenanceTask
methods.description: Maps a MaintenanceTask domain model to TaskDto.

methods.name: ToDto for Schedule
methods.description: Maps a Schedule domain model to ScheduleDto.
